card.name: Section numbers and headings starting a new entry
card.fires_on: Marks the start of a numbered sense or section: a digit like 1 or 2 after a dictionary headword or section number, or a colon or heading word after a dosage heading.

modes.label: Dictionary sense numbers
modes.description: A digit that begins a numbered definition after a medical term's pronunciation or hyphenation.
modes.example: non·i·den·ti·cal <<1>>. Not being the same; different.

modes.label: Dosage section headings
modes.description: A colon, heading word or part of a heading right after a dosage heading in a drug label.
modes.example: Initial Dose Regimen<<:>> Initiate eltrombopag tablets

modes.label: Subsection numbers
modes.description: The digit in a label subsection number such as 7.2.

card.plain: It fires on the number or heading marker that begins a new definition or dosing section.
